==Dialogue==
If The Toy's Story has not been completed:
:''"My husband has a knack for fun. His toys and games are like none I've ever seen. But, you can't feed a family on games and toys alone."''

If The Toy's Story has been completed:
:''"Everyone else just rushed by. Nobody had time to help us. I know there are corsairs and evil plants and all manner of unworldly things to worry about, but normal folk need help sometimes, too."''
